```{r load-data}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)

df_raw <- read_csv(
  "Holdout_Summary_Metrics_trimmedRF1comp_s1n10k_qs1n10k_s0n15k_qs0n15k.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Parse: split Stage ("2017 A raw") into year + stage; drop GEE columns
df1 <- df_raw %>%
  separate(Stage, into = c("year", "stage"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  select(-`system:index`, -.geo) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(year, stage), names_to = "stat") %>%
  mutate(
    year_f  = factor(year),
    stage_f = factor(stage, levels = c("A raw", "B gap-fill", "C final"))
  )
```

---

## Por año (color = stage)

Eje X = año, color = etapa del pipeline.

```{r plot-by-year}
df_perf <- df1 %>% filter(stat %in% c("OA", "Kappa", "F1", "PA_retama", "UA_retama"))
df_err  <- df1 %>% filter(stat %in% c("OE_retama", "CE_retama"))
df_cont <- df1 %>% filter(stat %in% c("TP", "FP", "FN", "TN"))

crear_plot <- function(data, titulo) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = year, y = value,
                   group = stage_f,
                   col = stage_f)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ stat, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(title = titulo, x = NULL, y = NULL, col = "Stage")
}

p1 <- crear_plot(df_perf, "Performance (Exactitud y Balance)")
p2 <- crear_plot(df_err,  "Errores (Omisión y Comisión)")
p3 <- crear_plot(df_cont, "Matriz de Confusión (Conteos)") + labs(x = "Año")

(p1 / p2 / p3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1, 1)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

---

## Por stage (color = año)

Eje X = etapa del pipeline, color = año. Paleta viridis discreta.

```{r plot-by-stage}
crear_plot_invertido <- function(data, titulo) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = stage_f, y = value,
                   group = year_f,
                   col = year_f)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ stat, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Año") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(title = titulo, x = NULL, y = NULL)
}

p1 <- crear_plot_invertido(df_perf, "Performance (Exactitud y Balance)")
p2 <- crear_plot_invertido(df_err,  "Errores (Omisión y Comisión)")
p3 <- crear_plot_invertido(df_cont, "Matriz de Confusión (Conteos)") + labs(x = "Stage")

(p1 / p2 / p3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1, 1)) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```
